user.title: Connect to YoLink Local Hub
user.description: Enter your YoLink Local Hub credentials. You can find these in the YoLink app under Local Hub → Local Network → Integrations → Local API.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the hub

init.title: Cloud hub diagnostics (optional)
init.description: Add read-only YoLink Cloud diagnostics for the hub. Local discovery, MQTT, sensors, and controls do not require these credentials. Leave the UAID and secret blank to disable cloud diagnostics.

data.cloud_hub_id: Hub Device EUI (optional if the account has one hub)

data_description.cloud_client_id: Personal Access Credential created under Account → Advanced Settings → Personal Access Credentials.
data_description.cloud_client_secret: Secret belonging to the Personal Access Credential.
data_description.cloud_hub_id: Selects the correct hub when the cloud account contains more than one.

error.cloud_credentials_incomplete: Enter both the Cloud UAID and secret key, or leave both blank to disable cloud diagnostics.
error.invalid_cloud_auth: The YoLink Cloud credentials were rejected.
error.invalid_cloud_hub: The requested hub was not found or could not be read with these cloud credentials.
error.cannot_connect_cloud: Could not connect to the YoLink Cloud API.
